name: Pallas Lounge Chair
description: The Pallas Lounge Chair invites you to relax in a cocoon of comfort, with its softly curved wings and rounded seat. Wrapped in sumptuous faux shearling, it artfully combines plush texture with a sense of inviting warmth. Meticulous craftsmanship is evident in every detail, from the subtle stitching and tufting to the elegantly rounded leg corners, enhancing its inviting, cozy appeal.
key_features: Faux Shearling material in Almond and Fawn
Tested to ANSI/BIFMA safety and durability standards

videos.label: Pallas Lounge Chair | Danish Design reduced to its essentials

name: Nova Lounge Chair
description: Lush materials and a curved mod silhouette infuse sophisticated richness to the Nova Chair. Softly padded for a comfortable seat and available in multiple fabric and color options, the Nova is the ideal accent piece to complete your space.
key_features: Upholstered frame padded with polyurethane foam wrapped in polyester fiber
Tested to ANSI/BIFMA safety and durability standards

videos.label: Nova Lounge Chair | Two Versions. One Icon.
Modern Radiance | Rove Concepts Home Series

name: Tola Lounge Chair
description:
The Tola Lounge Chair infuses any home with a sophisticated elegance, radiating a delightful harmony. With its plush, curved silhouette complemented by rich wood tones, the Tola effortlessly stands out in any living room.
 
Also available in a dining chair version here.
key_features: Black screws for the walnut frame
The backrest has softer firmness than the seat cushion
Tested to ANSI/BIFMA safety and durability standards

videos.label: Tola Lounge Chair | Inclusive luxury, reduced to essentials.

name: Mia Lounge Chair - Swivel
description: The Mia Lounge Chair - Swivel brings added flexibility to its signature sculptural shape. Softly upholstered curves create a comfortable and elegant feel, while the smooth swivel base allows for easy 360-degree movement. Designed with a refined modern look, Mia brings effortless style to any space.

name: Nova Lounge Chair - Swivel
description: Now available in a swivel design—Nova’s iconic curved silhouette and plush comfort take on new dimension with fluid, 360-degree movement. This latest addition brings a dynamic layer to the lounge experience, pairing the chair’s signature sophistication with effortless versatility. Ideal for open-concept spaces or cozy corners, the Swivel Nova invites relaxation from every angle.
key_features: Upholstered frame padded with polyurethane foam wrapped in polyester fiber
Kiln-dried hardwood frame for lasting durability
One vertical seam for subtle detail

videos.label: Nova Lounge Chair | Two Versions. One Icon.

name: Kyoto Dining Chair
description: The Kyoto Dining Chair brings a sense of calm intention to the table. Its composed silhouette and disciplined lines create an atmosphere of quiet ritual, where gathering feels unhurried and considered. Designed to feel grounded yet inviting, the chair balances structure with subtle comfort, encouraging longer moments of connection and pause. As part of the Rove Kyoto Collection, it reflects a philosophy of dining as an experience—rooted in presence and simplicity.
key_features: Part of the Rove Kyoto Collection

name: Hadrian Armchair
description: The Hadrian Armchair strikes the perfect balance between modern style and timeless design. Sculpted curves and sumptuous upholstery provide cloud-like comfort, while the crescent back hugs a generously cushioned seat. Crafted for optimal comfort and available in multiple color options, this armchair is the ideal accent piece to complete your space.
key_features: Available in Dune, Alesund, and Verdant
Kiln-dried hardwood frame with doweled joints and reinforced corner blocks
Soft-padded frame made with polyurethane foam wrapped in polyester fiber
Medium-Firm Feel  (Learn more about our sofa firmness here.)

name: Curva Lounge Chair
description: Relax and unwind with the Curva Lounge Chair. Crafted from natural rattan and accented with brushed brass details, this chair reimagines our beloved Mia Lounge Chair with a modern twist, making it perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. Wherever you place the Curva, it creates a high-impact design moment worthy of conversation.
key_features: Available in Alesund and Sage colors

videos.label: Rove Concepts x Rove Lab | Miami Showroom

name: Kyoto Armchair
description: The Kyoto Armchair is a meditation on form and stillness. Defined by strong lines and quiet geometry, it feels grounded yet intentional—an object that holds space rather than demands it. Its sculptural profile brings a sense of calm structure to the room, inviting moments of pause, reflection, and ease. Part of the Rove Kyoto Collection, the armchair embodies a considered approach to living—where design is felt as much as it is seen, and every detail exists with purpose.
key_features: Part of the Rove Kyoto Collection
Kyoto Truffle finish with deep-cut detailing

name: Forja Lounge Chair
description: The Forja Lounge Chair is a sculptural expression of craftsmanship and comfort. Defined by its hammered patina chocolate frame, the chair’s artisanal texture meets smooth, refined upholstery. Its grounded silhouette is softened with plush, removable cushions—bringing both durability and warmth to the modern lounge.

name: Loreto Lounge Chair
description: The Loreto Lounge Chair brings together sculptural form and everyday comfort. With its plush, textured upholstery and solid natural acacia arms, it offers a grounded yet inviting presence—perfect for relaxed living.
key_features: Natural rubber wood arms in natural acacia

name: Study Chair by Maria Sharapova
description:
Part of Maria Sharapova’s second collection, The Study Chair by Maria Sharapova brings refined ease to the modern office. Designed for comfort and versatility, it moves effortlessly from desk to dining or accent seating. With a sculptural form, plush cushioning, and rich Acacia finishes, it’s function wrapped in elegance.
 
Shop the entire Maria collection here.
key_features: Solid Natural Acacia wood frame in Almond, Espresso, or Fawn
Upholstered seat with foam and fiber padding
Adjustable glides on all four legs
